name: Omnipotent Edge
lore: A blade with no thickness and no limit. What it cuts has never existed.
concept: a sword with an edge of no thickness: white-gold hilt and guard, the blade is a sliver of absolute light whose edge is a hairline of void; light travels along the edge; occasional afterimages of the blade being in several places at once

name: Scepter of Singularities
lore: It does not fire singularities. It decides where one has always been.
concept: a scepter/staff: dark violet shaft with gold bands, at its head a held singularity that cycles: black hole (dark with ring), white hole (bright burst), tesseract (wireframe cube), entanglement (two linked motes), big bang (flash) - matching its five modes

name: Crown of Transcendence
lore: You see everything, because nothing can hide from what is outside it.
concept: helmet-icon: a crown/circlet of white-gold with a floating halo above it and an eye-like gem; the halo slowly turns

name: Mantle of Omnipotence
lore: Harm needs a law to happen by. You are wearing all of them.
concept: chestplate-icon: radiant white-gold breastplate with a sun-like emblem; a soft rippling prismatic cape-glow behind it

name: Greaves of the Absolute
lore: Distance is a law. You may keep it or not.
concept: leggings-icon: white-gold greaves with cyan light lines running down them like distance being folded

name: Treads of Infinity
lore: Every step lands. None of them fall.
concept: boots-icon: white-gold boots with a pink/violet infinity sign (lemniscate) glowing on them, small motes stepping on nothing

name: Lawgiver's Codex
lore: Blank, until you write. Then the place you stand in obeys what you wrote.
concept: a thick leather-and-gold tome; it opens by itself, golden law-lines write themselves across the pages, the pages turn, it closes; a quill mark
